blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University clinched a Final Four berth after escaping La Salle, 74-72, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday at Araneta Coliseum. The Tamaraws booked their first trip to the semifinals since 2022 after ending the elimination round with a 9-5 record. FEU also earned a shot to gain a twice-to-beat advantage against the loser of the game between University of the Philippines (9-4) and National University (9-4), which is currently taking place as of posting time.
